english.default: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||

translation.spanish: Aquél que entona su mirada hacia Ti es emancipado, mientras que los pobres arrogantes Manmukjs están destinados a vagar a través de muchos vientres maternos. (2)

english.default: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, always dwelling with the Lord.

translation.spanish: Sólo aquél que está entonado en el Uno, es redimido y puede habitar en su Señor.

english.default: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him.
